questions.q:
Comprehension:
In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.
SEBI’s interim order relating to an employee _____1_____trades of Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) shows _____2______lapses in the process followed by the insurance _____3_____ when dealing with clients’ investments. While the stock market regulator has _______4______ stringent rules for the entire investment process in mutual funds — from decision making to placing orders on exchanges — to prevent _____5_____and unfair trading practices, insurance companies which manage equally substantial amounts of money do not appear to have water-tight rules to prevent such incidents.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
questions.solution:
B) 'front-running'का use होगा क्योंकि यहाँ passage में mention है कि SEBI की अंतरिम आदेश में एक कर्मचारी के "front-running" की व्याख्या की गई है। "Front-running" एक तरह की गलत प्रयासवादी व्यापारिक गतिविधि होती है जहाँ एक व्यक्ति एक सूचीबद्ध क्लाइंट के आदेशों को उनके पहले के पहुंचने से पहले फायदा उठाता है। अन्य options में, 'fine-tuning' का अर्थ होता है छोटे-मोटे सुधार करना, 'reassuring' का अर्थ होता है साहस या विश्वास दिलाना, और 'tweaking' का अर्थ होता है समीक्षा करना या सुधारना, जो इस context में सही नहीं हैं।
'front-running' will be used because it has been explicitly mentioned in the passage that SEBI's interim order addresses an employee's "front-running" trades. "Front-running" is a type of illicit trading activity where an individual benefits from executing orders on behalf of a listed client before their official execution. Among the other options, 'fine-tuning' means making minor adjustments, 'reassuring' means providing courage or confidence, and 'tweaking' means reviewing or modifying, which are not appropriate in this context.

questions.q:
Comprehension:
In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.
SEBI’s interim order relating to an employee _____1_____trades of Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) shows _____2______lapses in the process followed by the insurance _____3_____ when dealing with clients’ investments. While the stock market regulator has _______4______ stringent rules for the entire investment process in mutual funds — from decision making to placing orders on exchanges — to prevent _____5_____and unfair trading practices, insurance companies which manage equally substantial amounts of money do not appear to have water-tight rules to prevent such incidents.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
questions.solution:
D) 'Alarming' का use होगा क्योंकि 'alarming' का अर्थ होता है कुछ ऐसा जो चिंता या भय पैदा करे। Sentence में mention है कि SEBI का आदेश दिखाता है कि बीमा कंपनी के प्रक्रिया में गंभीर त्रुटियां हैं, जो चिंताजनक हैं, इसलिए 'alarming' यहाँ सही है। जबकि 'Discouraging' का अर्थ है हतोत्साहित करना, 'Cloning' का अर्थ है नकल करना, और 'Inhibiting' का अर्थ है रोकना या बाधित करना, जो इस context में सही नहीं है।
'Alarming' will be used because it means something that causes worry or fear. The sentence indicates that SEBI’s order reveals serious faults in the insurance company's process, which are concerning, making 'alarming' appropriate here. Whereas, 'Discouraging' means to dishearten, 'Cloning' means to copy, and 'Inhibiting' means to hinder or restrain, which don't fit in this context.

questions.q:
Comprehension:
In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.
SEBI’s interim order relating to an employee _____1_____trades of Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) shows _____2______lapses in the process followed by the insurance _____3_____ when dealing with clients’ investments. While the stock market regulator has _______4______ stringent rules for the entire investment process in mutual funds — from decision making to placing orders on exchanges — to prevent _____5_____and unfair trading practices, insurance companies which manage equally substantial amounts of money do not appear to have water-tight rules to prevent such incidents.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
questions.solution:
B) 'Behemoth'का use होगा क्योंकि "behemoth" का अर्थ होता है कोई बहुत बड़ी और शक्तिशाली चीज। Sentence में mention है कि insurance company जो कि बड़ी मात्रा में पैसा manage करती है, उसे दर्शाने के लिए 'behemoth' यहाँ सही है। जबकि 'Inaugurate' का अर्थ होता है किसी चीज का उद्घाटन करना, 'Coherent' का अर्थ होता है तार्किक और सुसंगत, और 'Impoverish' का अर्थ होता है गरीब बनाना, जो इस context में सही नहीं है।
'Behemoth' will be used because it means a very large and powerful entity. The sentence describes an insurance company that manages large amounts of money, making 'behemoth' suitable here to indicate its size and power. Whereas, 'Inaugurate' means to formally open or introduce something, 'Coherent' means logical and consistent, and 'Impoverish' means to make poor, which do not fit in this context.

questions.q:
Comprehension:
In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.
SEBI’s interim order relating to an employee _____1_____trades of Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) shows _____2______lapses in the process followed by the insurance _____3_____ when dealing with clients’ investments. While the stock market regulator has _______4______ stringent rules for the entire investment process in mutual funds — from decision making to placing orders on exchanges — to prevent _____5_____and unfair trading practices, insurance companies which manage equally substantial amounts of money do not appear to have water-tight rules to prevent such incidents.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4
questions.solution:
C) "laid down"का use होगा क्योंकि "laid down" का अर्थ होता है नियम या आदेश निर्धारित करना। passage में mention है कि म्यूचुअल फंड्स के लिए निवेश प्रक्रिया में कठोर नियम लागू किए गए हैं जिससे अनुचित व्यापारिक प्रथाओं को रोका जा सके, इसलिए 'laid down' यहाँ सही है। जबकि 'Led down' का अर्थ है गलत दिशा में ले जाना, 'Call upon' का अर्थ है मदद के लिए बुलाना, और 'make up' का अर्थ है बनाना या गढ़ना, जो इस context में सही नहीं है।
"laid down" will be used because "laid down" means to establish rules or directives. The passage mentions that stringent rules have been established for the investment process in mutual funds to prevent improper and unfair trading practices, making 'laid down' suitable here. Whereas, 'Led down' implies misleading or directing in the wrong way, 'Call upon' means to request for help, and 'make up' means to create or fabricate, which don't fit in this context.

questions.q:
Comprehension:
In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.
SEBI’s interim order relating to an employee _____1_____trades of Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) shows _____2______lapses in the process followed by the insurance _____3_____ when dealing with clients’ investments. While the stock market regulator has _______4______ stringent rules for the entire investment process in mutual funds — from decision making to placing orders on exchanges — to prevent _____5_____and unfair trading practices, insurance companies which manage equally substantial amounts of money do not appear to have water-tight rules to prevent such incidents.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5
questions.solution:
C) Fraudulent'का use होगा क्योंकि "fraudulent" का अर्थ होता है धोखाधड़ी से संबंधित। passage में mention है कि म्यूचुअल फंड्स में निवेश प्रक्रिया को कड़ाई से नियंत्रित किया जाता है ताकि धोखाधड़ी और अनुचित व्यापारिक प्रथाओं को रोका जा सके, इसलिए 'fraudulent' यहाँ सही है। जबकि 'Equivalent' का अर्थ है बराबर का, 'Relent' का अर्थ है नरम पड़ना, और 'Blunt' का अर्थ है भद्दा या मुखर, जो इस संदर्भ में सही नहीं है।
Fraudulent' will be used because it means related to deceit or dishonest practices. The passage mentions that mutual funds have stringent rules to prevent fraudulent and unfair trading practices, making 'fraudulent' fitting here. Whereas, 'Equivalent' means equal in value or amount, 'Relent' means to soften in attitude or temper, and 'Blunt' means straightforward without sensitivity, which don't fit in this context.
